evidence.title: Two-level domain-decomposition AdaGrad method for scalable training of graph neural networks

summary: Researchers introduce a novel AdaGrad optimization method using two-level domain decomposition to improve the scalability of training large graph neural networks. The approach aims to address computational bottlenecks in distributed learning environments.
title: New Two-Level Domain-Decomposition AdaGrad Method Enhances Scalability of Graph Neural Network Training
